title: aew-attitude-era-2015-world-heavyweight
label: Roman Reigns

won.source: Its Aries roleplay: 'Roman Reigns was the one that left the TD Garden as the new AEW World Heavyweight Champion'. Its Corino roleplay is headed '[05/03/15] Wrestle War!' and its directory stamps the roleplay 30 April 2015 and the Wrestle War folder page 4 May 2015, which reads the date month first (3 May 2015); the Aries roleplay, stamped 27 May, speaks of the event as past.

lost.source: No later page survives; the Aries roleplay of 27 May 2015 is the last.

how: Won the Wrestle War match (a match the Aries roleplay says Austin Aries lost when Goldust eliminated him, with Steve Corino billed against Everyone).
